scope: independent acceptance specification, NOT an acceptance receipt
prerequisites: A reviews and publishes actual integrated SHA
B-owned consumers updated to real new behavior
actual environment and all evidence paths frozen

rows.trusted_inputs_required: published exact SHA plus frozen interpreter/dependency files; controller and worker actual loaded code
rows.actual_consequence_required: same current assertions actually execute; stale-source positive cannot be issued
rows.legal_positive: fresh source real positive and current intentional-failure control
rows.negative_and_invariants: unchecked/timestamp/assertion-rewrite caches; preloaded/downstream foreign code; drift; no weak fallback

rows.trusted_inputs_required: four complete package files generated at fixed SHA; all output paths distinct and absolute
rows.actual_consequence_required: current package consumed; no stale v2 or source-evidence writes into input domain
rows.legal_positive: full real generation precedes consumers; sys.executable consistent with verified interpreter
rows.negative_and_invariants: missing attribution, bundle replacement, mixed package/source, cached tests, old shebang, missing/duplicate nodes

rows.trusted_inputs_required: legitimate current-source reference, 31 nonnoop mutations and archived actual bytes
rows.consumer: real standalone and main verification CLI
rows.actual_consequence_required: reference MATCH, every attack REJECTED with precise stage; preserved artifacts
rows.legal_positive: legitimate reference passes each batch
rows.negative_and_invariants: no-op, missing/duplicate bundle, source-stale-only rejection for semantic attack, weak/self-consistent receipt

rows.trusted_inputs_required: same causal visible history; real provenance-bound model and posterior IDs
rows.producer: default H/R/I/C/Z/r/V with three RB blocks
rows.consumer: OPCEU ORRER PCHMP CF-BOCPD CCRR RGRC CIAV
rows.actual_consequence_required: registered support normalized posterior reaches unique ledger and action consumer
rows.legal_positive: nonempty real posterior -> approved conditional statistics -> posterior/action changes under relevant legal intervention
rows.negative_and_invariants: foreign posterior/support, overflow, unrelated perturbation; complete rollback

rows.affirmative_output: direct P5 learns stable long-term habit
rows.trusted_inputs_required: identical triarm public history; no extra P5 warmup/forced grant/private injection
rows.producer: direct production P5 -> real CCRR eligibility -> RGRC
rows.actual_consequence_required: positive committed contribution with correct owner/location; measured full-versus-fast contribution and later action sensitivity
rows.legal_positive: predeclared stable habit history admits real nonempty qualified writes
rows.negative_and_invariants: unqualified/nonhabit/unknown evidence never gains unauthorized long-term contribution; no mandatory count hack

rows.trusted_inputs_required: common precommitted candidate action/outcome/cost/privacy contract
rows.actual_consequence_required: causal posterior/memory/decision response; actual observation cost recorded
rows.legal_positive: same location, different location, not observed
rows.negative_and_invariants: unchanged unrelated object/person; invalid target/late result rejected or contractually replayed

rows.trusted_inputs_required: shared handoff histories, unknown actor, similar objects with distinct IDs
rows.consumer: typed target posterior and owner memory
rows.actual_consequence_required: correct individual ownership and object action; unresolved mass remains legal
rows.legal_positive: known/unknown handoff resolves only with legitimate evidence
rows.negative_and_invariants: identity change must not be mistaken for true habit change; other object state invariant

rows.trusted_inputs_required: stable/change/return histories with person identity controlled
rows.actual_consequence_required: correct active phase, retained/revived old statistics, actual action consequence
rows.legal_positive: new phase and return both nonempty
rows.negative_and_invariants: actor-only change vs habit-only change; unrelated factors invariant

rows.trusted_inputs_required: qualified nonempty parent from ordinary legal production history; public request
rows.consumer: committed records, hybrid ledger, fast memory, action distribution
rows.actual_consequence_required: old contribution removed; new positive mass/location present once; qualification correct
rows.legal_positive: same/different location correction; duplicate rejects/no double count
rows.negative_and_invariants: invalid correction preserves ledger/state/operator identities; no ghost observation

rows.trusted_inputs_required: same-run provenance and qualified parent contributions, late/duplicate/out-of-order input
rows.actual_consequence_required: exact once contribution; rejected child does not erase valid parent; later actions use restored state
rows.legal_positive: each lifecycle edge with nonempty parent/child, recovery after interruption
rows.negative_and_invariants: fault at hybrid/Dirichlet/RLS and later consumer points; illegal transitions fully rollback; compare clean reference

rows.trusted_inputs_required: common initial world and budget, committed typed action, genuine feedback
rows.consumer: environment state -> execution feedback -> next inference
rows.actual_consequence_required: separate search success, put-back success, world-state transition, subsequent belief/action; no command-only success
rows.legal_positive: real legal execution changes world as expected
rows.negative_and_invariants: failed/blocked/privacy-denied execution changes no forbidden state; no evaluator-injected success

rows.trusted_inputs_required: legal tagged histories with late counterevidence and stable owner truth released after commits
rows.actual_consequence_required: actual inappropriate long-term mass and its removal measured; not current-location error proxy
rows.legal_positive: nonempty lawful learning plus reversible erroneous attribution
rows.negative_and_invariants: zero-commit vacuity fails coverage; irrelevant input preserves unrelated contributions

rows.trusted_inputs_required: frozen public-map permission or user-approved causal-prefix rule
rows.actual_consequence_required: actual consumed location set traced by time/source; future leaks rejected only under explicit contract
rows.legal_positive: known public map and ordinary scenes retained
rows.negative_and_invariants: future-only location without permission; support substitutions

rows.affirmative_output: missing-owner prior consistent with chosen contract
rows.trusted_inputs_required: actual owner estimate availability, explicitly chosen shared/default prior
rows.actual_consequence_required: 53 missing-owner steps and 17 historical difference reconciled, new actual values unconstrained
rows.legal_positive: original and separately labelled common-prior development control
rows.negative_and_invariants: prior changed silently; missing treated as observed; P5-only warmup

rows.affirmative_output: evidence rights and actual features match
rows.trusted_inputs_required: identical causal packet; authorized map/actor/negative evidence/feedback fields
rows.producer: visible packet and actual feature extraction
rows.consumer: all three adapters, learned feature vector, memory
rows.actual_consequence_required: per-field access and values traced, unused information reported rather than falsely called equal capability
rows.legal_positive: real same inputs with legal targeted feature intervention
rows.negative_and_invariants: early truth/future evidence, ordered-role dropped without declared limitation; wrong target

rows.trusted_inputs_required: train/validation/test IDs, frozen parameter grids, traceable model artifact
rows.producer: training-only fitting; validation action commit then scoring
rows.actual_consequence_required: actual fit count/access order recorded; no test-driven tuning
rows.legal_positive: valid training and independent validation selection
rows.negative_and_invariants: cross-split access, precommit validation truth, changed seed retries; no confirmation relabel

rows.trusted_inputs_required: frozen scientific limits where present; actual model sizes, fit records, hardware/cache/load
rows.actual_consequence_required: parameters/operations/observation/time/privacy separately measured; zero costs not net utility
rows.legal_positive: controlled sequential repeated measurement with fixed cache/warmup range
rows.negative_and_invariants: parallel contention speed claims, information matching called equal compute, missing cost treated as zero

rows.trusted_inputs_required: legal distinct method location posteriors, identical observations/support/common decoder and ties
rows.consumer: common SEARCH decoder and real executor
rows.actual_consequence_required: legal posterior intervention changes readout/action when decision boundary crossed; raw native posterior not silently discarded
rows.legal_positive: ordinary and strong-baseline cases with variation carried through adapter
rows.negative_and_invariants: three copied detected-location distributions mistaken for equivalence; private alternative protocol passed off as original

rows.trusted_inputs_required: same legal candidates/outcomes/cost/privacy budget and action timing
rows.actual_consequence_required: actual permissions and budget consumption match contract
rows.legal_positive: positive/negative observation, privacy-blocked event
rows.negative_and_invariants: one arm extra observation, outcome after truth, absent cost record; no unilateral shared-decoder changes

rows.affirmative_output: frozen final utility and guardrails established
rows.trusted_inputs_required: authorized final protocol and still-sealed confirmation source with provenance
rows.actual_consequence_required: registered uncertainty, threshold and guardrails satisfied with complete scope
rows.legal_positive: authorized unseen/externally valid replication after engineering gates
rows.negative_and_invariants: opened D0 relabelled unseen, metric/0.02 changed, seed shopping, router calibration early

numerics: Use frozen protocol full_rerun_equivalence tolerances; do not select new tolerances post hoc. Exact mutation identity is not an approximate posterior test.
